test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes L. M. Thapar as a beloved figure whose personality, generosity, and support for young talent are positively remembered.
 
• Therefore, **"fondly" **is the most** appropriate option** as it conveys warm and affectionate memories.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4: fondly**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"His vivacious personality, his generosity and his encouragement of young talent is remembered **fondly **by his friends, family and admirers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eventually:** This word suggests something that happens after a period of time, which does not fit the context of being remembered.
 
• **Sometimes:** This word suggests occasional remembrance, which does not fit the passage indicating consistent, affectionate memory.
 
• **Never:** This word contradicts the idea that he is positively remembered by many people.
